skill.name: brief-generator
skill.description: Use when the user asks to create an influencer brief or write a campaign brief. It builds creator-ready briefs with deliverables, key messages, creative direction, timelines, disclosure rules, usage rights, and compensation terms. It does not allocate spend across creators; use budget-optimizer for that.
skill.summary: Create structured influencer briefs with deliverables, messaging, compliance terms, timelines, and compensation details.

The flagged items are Markdown links, fenced examples, inline file paths, homepage metadata, and ordinary influencer-brief compliance language.

content.value_statement: Creator campaigns often stall because briefs miss deliverables, disclosures, and timelines. This skill creates structured influencer briefs for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.
actual_capabilities: Collects campaign inputs such as brand, product, platform, deliverables, CTA, timeline, and compensation.
Creates creator-ready briefs with overview, key messages, creative direction, deliverables, approval steps, and FAQ sections.
Adds platform-specific guidance for TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, ambassador, launch, review, event, and giveaway campaigns.
Includes disclosure requirements, usage rights, content restrictions, and compensation terms in the brief.
Can use a creator voice intake reference to make the brief fit the creator style.
Can save the finished brief and promote durable campaign facts when the host supports local memory files.
limitations: It does not choose creators or allocate spend across creators.
It depends on user-provided campaign details and approved claim wording.
It cannot verify current platform specifications without optional analytics or platform data connectors.
It provides brief structure and compliance prompts, not legal advice.

use_cases.title: Standardize Launch Briefs
use_cases.description: Create consistent briefs for multiple creators across TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube before a product launch.

use_cases.title: Prepare Client Campaigns
use_cases.description: Turn client goals, assets, timelines, and approval rules into a reusable creator brief format.

use_cases.title: Brief Ambassador Partners
use_cases.description: Convert campaign notes into a clear ambassador brief with deliverables, voice guidance, and usage rights.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Campaign Brief
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner prompt for a single campaign.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an influencer brief for [campaign]. Include brand, product, platform, deliverables, key message, CTA, timeline, disclosure, and compensation.

prompt_templates.title: Platform-Specific Brief
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate prompt for multi-platform creator work.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a TikTok and Instagram creator brief for [product]. Include one Reel, one Story set, one TikTok video, platform specs, draft deadlines, and #ad disclosure.

prompt_templates.title: Voice-Aware Creator Brief
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt using creator voice details.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a creator brief for [creator] using this voice intake: [voice notes]. Keep required messages clear, but preserve the creator style and signature moves.

prompt_templates.title: Reusable Program Brief
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt for repeatable ambassador campaigns.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a reusable ambassador brief template for [brand]. Include recurring deliverables, approval workflow, content restrictions, usage rights, reporting requirements, and handoff notes.

output_examples.input: Create a brief for micro-influencers promoting a new organic protein powder on Instagram and TikTok.
output_examples.output: A creator-ready brief covering campaign goal, clean-label messaging, one Instagram Reel, one TikTok video, morning routine concepts, #ad placement, timeline, compensation, and 12-month usage rights.

output_examples.input: Write a YouTube integration brief for a SaaS productivity tool with a free trial CTA.
output_examples.output: A structured YouTube brief with intro talking points, demo requirements, trial CTA, description link rules, review milestones, claim restrictions, and analytics due dates.

output_examples.input: Create an ambassador brief that reflects a creator voice intake.
output_examples.output: A brand-safe ambassador brief that includes the creator voice, signature content moves, approved messages, content boundaries, posting cadence, and reporting expectations.

best_practices: Provide campaign goal, deliverables, platform, CTA, timeline, compensation, and approved claim wording before generation.
State disclosure requirements, usage rights, and content restrictions clearly before creators start work.
Use the creator voice intake when authenticity matters or past briefs caused too many revisions.
anti_patterns: Using this skill to split budget across creators instead of using budget-optimizer.
Treating the generated brief as a rigid script that removes creator voice.
Leaving placeholders for disclosure, usage rights, claims, or compensation in the final brief.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates structured influencer campaign briefs with deliverables, messaging, creative direction, compliance terms, timelines, and compensation details.

faq.question: Does it work with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill is declared as compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code skill hosts.

faq.question: Can it make platform-specific briefs?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for TikTok, Instagram formats, YouTube integrations, Shorts, launches, reviews, events, ambassadors, and giveaways.

faq.question: Does it handle legal compliance?
faq.answer: It includes disclosure, usage rights, and restriction prompts, but it is not a substitute for legal review.

faq.question: Can it use a creator voice?
faq.answer: Yes. It can use the included creator voice intake to preserve tone, sentence patterns, and signature moves.

faq.question: What information should I provide first?
faq.answer: Provide the campaign goal, brand, product, platforms, content types, quantities, key messages, CTA, timeline, budget, and compensation terms.
